C8 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
Shrinking the step is a variance argument, not new information. It stops the model
losing; it cannot make it win. If C6 passes it passes on a SMALL positive R2, and
the honest reading is that the model has learned to move a little in roughly the
right direction -- not that it simulates anything.
r^2 is estimated from the same held-out predictions it then scales, so the shrinkage
is mildly optimistic. A nested split would cost coverage this gene set cannot spare.
